synthesis: Human single-dose piperine increased exposure; repeated rat co-treatment decreased exposure despite metabolic inhibition. Species/regimen/context differ. Microsomal inhibition is a separate assay result; no common effect coefficient.

Isolated piperine study reported longer sedation/lower clearance; short-term curcuminoid/piperine mixture showed no meaningful parent-midazolam PK change. Different preparation/regimen; not a pure same-intervention replication.
Rat oral exposure increased; human tamoxifen exposure decreased with curcumin with/without piperine. Different species and metabolites; curcumin-only human endoxifen contrast p=0.07.
Cell assays showed antagonism; xenografts showed concentration dependence and no antagonism at 11-16 uM, but antagonism above 200 uM. No human clinical interaction established.
